reasons: Both ACs are exercised end-to-end through the real user path: Perps home -> tap BTC row -> Lite -> Pro -> Lite -> header back arrow, using only ui.press/ui.navigate and the typed metamask.perps.ensure_mode action.
The graph validates (mm-harness run --plan exits 0) and every ac<N>- node has a passing entry in artifacts/trace.json.

A sibling recipe-baseline.json asserts the buggy values and passes against pre-fix code, producing honest before-evidence; the verify recipe asserts the fixed values and fails on pre-fix code, so it genuinely tests the fix.
Both visual/mixed screenshots are preceded by a ui.wait_for on the claimed target, and the before/after PNGs show opposite destinations (wallet home token list vs Perps home balance screen).
No forbidden patterns: no switch/default, no eval_sync, no wait substituting for ui.wait_for, no fiber-only proof for a visual claim, and no UI value injection.

intent_clarity.reason: Every node intent states the human-visible goal rather than restating the action, selector, or node id.
evidence: mm-harness run --plan reports no workflow.invalid_intent findings.

coverage.reason: 2/2 ACs PROVEN, none untestable, weak, or missing.

evidence_fit.reason: AC1 (mixed) is carried by state assertions plus a before/after screenshot pair; AC2 (visual) by screenshots gated on ui.wait_for targets. No screenshot is used as proof for hidden behavior.

revert_sensitivity.reason: Reverting the fix makes both new unit tests fail and makes the verify recipe's AC1 assertion fail, while the baseline recipe passes only against buggy code.
evidence: Reverted-fix jest run reported 2 failed, 13 passed
baseline recipe run exited 0 pre-fix and the verify recipe exits 0 post-fix.
